description: Trigger discrimination for membership-invitation workflow design: token/binding/seat/spam semantics versus invitation state semantics (tenant-modeler), role-grant rules (authorization-matrix-designer), plan seat pools (plan-entitlement-architect), the rate-limit contract (api-event-architect), email/notification UX (notification-webhook-ux-designer), token hardening (secrets-identity-hardener, manual-only), the audit schema (audit-log-architect), and executable negative suites (multi-tenant-security-tester, manual-only).

cases.prompt: Design the invite-by-email flow: single-use tokens, identity binding at acceptance, seat checks, and invite-spam limits.
cases.reason: Token/binding/seat/spam semantics on top of the existing state machine are this skill's design; the state machine and the grant rules are its inputs.

cases.prompt: Model the invitation lifecycle — the states, transitions, and who may invite.
cases.reason: Invitation states and transitions are tenant-modeler's scope; this skill composes its state machine.

cases.prompt: Design which role each inviter may grant in an invitation.
cases.reason: Who may grant which role (the grant ceiling) is authorization-matrix-designer's scope; the invitation composes it.

cases.prompt: Decide how many seats each plan includes and what happens beyond the limit.
cases.reason: The plan seat pool is plan-entitlement-architect's scope; the invitation design reads it.

cases.prompt: Design the per-tenant and per-user rate limits for our API endpoints.
cases.reason: The rate-limit contract is api-event-architect's scope; the invite-spam limits consume it.

cases.prompt: Design the invitation email — the template, the copy, and the notification flow.
cases.reason: The email/notification UX is notification-webhook-ux-designer's scope; this skill designs the workflow the email serves.

cases.prompt: Explicitly invoke secrets-identity-hardener. Design how invitation tokens are generated, stored, and rotated securely.
cases.reason: Token generation and storage hardening are secrets-identity-hardener's (manual-only); this skill designs token SEMANTICS only.

cases.prompt: Design the audit record schema for invitation-sent and invitation-accepted events.
cases.reason: The audit record schema is audit-log-architect's scope; the workflow emits into its taxonomy.

cases.prompt: Explicitly invoke multi-tenant-security-tester. Build the executable negative suite proving an invitee of tenant A cannot accept into tenant B.
cases.reason: Executable cross-tenant negative suites are multi-tenant-security-tester's (manual-only); the design names the negative cases, the tester builds the suite.
